scope: Local frontend and finance API changes. No deployment, account changes, real business submissions or payments.

findings.title: Certificate requests can disappear behind a success message
findings.implementation: Replaced simulated certificate success with an explicit WhatsApp draft; fields remain editable, with selectable text and email fallback. Backend ticket persistence remains future work.

findings.title: Quote confirmation precedes the actual WhatsApp message
findings.implementation: Preserved existing honest quote copy; kept the page open during handoff and added copy/email fallbacks with no delivery claim.

findings.title: Financial dashboard failures look like real zero balances
findings.implementation: Accounting and driver overview errors stop loading, show explicit failure/retry, and never substitute successful zero balances for failures.

findings.title: Read-only finance rows have no keyboard route to detail
findings.implementation: Finance requester names are native detail links with keyboard access and normal link behavior.

findings.title: Proof uploads cannot be reached using the keyboard
findings.implementation: Proof picker is tabbable with visible focus, associated requirements/errors and determinate or indeterminate progress semantics.

findings.title: Collection-point toggles are mouse-only
findings.implementation: Both toggle entry points use the same native checkbox switch, stable setting name and visible focus.

findings.title: Text and primary-button contrast need stronger tokens
findings.implementation: Extended the existing brand-700/800 action colours across bespoke public and operations controls; readable light-surface slate-400 copy and placeholders use slate-600. Corrected active navigation, progress labels, activity dates and supporting text. Preserved decorative graphics and disabled-state styles. Computed browser contrast checks cover sign-in action and helper copy; white on brand-700 is 5.84:1 and slate-600 on white is 7.58:1. This addresses the audited tokens, not a claim that every page is WCAG certified.

findings.title: Floating WhatsApp button overlaps the phone callback action
findings.implementation: Floating WhatsApp is suppressed on pickup, quote, contact and certificate forms; sticky pickup CTA is suppressed on certificates too.

findings.title: The initial pickup choice has no way back
findings.implementation: Change request type returns to the selector; mounted forms preserve drafts while switching.

findings.title: Business requests inherit household-focused page framing
findings.implementation: Business flow has its own hero and an in-flow scope/quotation/phone scheduling explanation.

findings.title: Track & Trace is difficult to discover for returning customers
findings.implementation: Added a visible status/certificate destination to desktop and mobile navigation, with a concise visible label and complete accessible name. Verified that the header fits at 1200px.

findings.title: Validation rules and error presentation have two competing owners
findings.implementation: Public step and callback forms now own their domain validation via an explicit ValidatedForm mode. Blur and Continue use the same localized errors, summary links focus the affected field, and unsupported text/length rules remain enforced.

findings.title: Inline field errors are not programmatically connected
findings.implementation: Inline domain errors are linked to the audited input, password, phone, select, textarea and address controls through stable IDs and invalid state.

findings.title: Several search and filter controls lack accessible names
findings.implementation: Shared search inputs expose persistent accessible names, finance status/sort controls have explicit names, and calling-code selectors are named, including localized public EN/BM labels.

findings.title: Finance records cannot be located beyond a status filter
findings.implementation: Added backend-supported requester/driver/order/request-reference search, inclusive MYT creation dates and allowlisted sorting. The UI debounces search, clears selection on filter changes, displays active filters and provides Clear all.

findings.title: Finance table omits currency context and numeric alignment
findings.implementation: Finance amounts use one MYR formatter with two decimal places, grouping, tabular numerals, right alignment and explicit currency headings. Unknown amounts remain a dash.

findings.title: Pagination can override the server total with a partial page
findings.implementation: Pagination uses the server total instead of inferring a total from a partial page. Loading and empty ranges are coherent, and finance resets to page 1 if a requested page disappears. Covered partial-page totals and HTTP 404 recovery.

findings.title: Filtered finance results use a first-use empty message
findings.implementation: Filtered finance results now say No matching finance records with Clear filters, while genuinely empty accounts keep their onboarding explanation.

findings.title: Driver route summary counts only the fetched page
findings.implementation: Open-route stop count uses the existing server aggregate rather than the fetched preview page.

findings.title: Session recovery discards the intended destination
findings.implementation: Middleware and client guards preserve local return destinations. Password and OTP login resolve destinations against the refreshed user role; malformed, external and wrong-role destinations fall back to the role home.

findings.title: Public language choice does not carry into operations
findings.implementation: Public EN/BM choice persists through a shared language preference cookie into portal sign-in and auth screens. Added a small shared locale provider and reusable switcher, translated shared role navigation, notification controls, finance filters/table/pagination and reimbursement UI. Switching language preserves credentials, OTP entry and finance filters; portal role URLs and permissions are unchanged. Auth dictionaries are reused rather than duplicated. Other operational pages and server-provided error/notification content still need translation; BM mode displays an availability notice on unsupported pages. Batch 4 extends BM to finance detail labels/statuses, dated payment history, payout viewing/editing/history and activity interface labels. Prices and item totals now use the same MYR formatter as the list. Known audit labels/enums are translated for display; names, bank account strings, identifiers, notes and the stored audit payload remain untouched. Nested desktop sidebar links now translate too. Full operational and backend-message localization is still incomplete. Batch 5 adds the accounting overview, shared welcome/profile labels and mobile command card, chart range controls, locale-aware chart dates, and loading/empty/error/retry copy. Date-range state and original profile data survive language changes. The accounting overview now uses the shared MYR formatter. Batch 6 covers claims list/detail, driver submission and vehicle states, approval/rejection and same-driver bulk-payment dialogs. Status/category labels, filter names, dates, totals, upload requirements and errors use BM copy. Shared select, upload and toast labels are localized. Sidebar section keys remain stable across language changes. Server-authored messages and other operational modules still require follow-up. Batch 7 extends BM to the driver pickup list/detail, route optimization/preview, collection confirmation and route drop-off, plus shared order documents, lifecycle, payment and activity tabs. Customer names, categories, addresses, notes, IDs and navigation targets remain data values. Admin/staff pickup administration and receiving workflows still need translation.

findings.title: Successful public requests leave no durable on-page receipt
findings.implementation: Accepted callback and business requests show an on-page confirmation with the server-acknowledged ID, masked contact number and next steps. Starting another request is explicit; redundant success toasts were removed.

findings.title: Public animation does not consistently respect reduced motion
findings.implementation: Added a shared reduced-motion preference and scrolling wrapper. Hero/reveal content honors the preference, Lenis uses native wheel behavior, and global CSS suppresses decorative animations/transitions. Changing the preference preserves drafts.

findings.title: An old invoice prototype remains publicly reachable
findings.implementation: The obsolete invoice prototype now returns 404 using getStaticProps, preserving its source as an internal archive.

findings.title: Password visibility control is too small and suppresses focus
findings.implementation: Password visibility has a 44px target, visible focus, input end padding and explicit password autocomplete modes.

verification.typescript: Passed after batch 8, including standalone check-types and production-build type validation.
verification.changed_file_eslint: Passed for changed frontend source/configuration/tests; backend unchanged in batches 3–8.
verification.mocked_regression_suite: 65 frontend tests passed against the isolated production build after batch 7. Six new driver cases cover BM route selection and previews at mobile/desktop sizes, seven-stop limit, Malaysia-local schedule prefilling from list and detail with UTC round-trip, collection proof and unchanged notes/payment codes, collection-point retry/location denial, and drop-off quantity/upload guards with original IDs and precise quantities. Every business API and storage write is mocked; geolocation uses synthetic values/errors.
verification.final_public_flow_recheck: Reviewed BM driver route preview at 390px and 1440px and the schedule confirmation dialog. Order codes, addresses and user names remain original data; dialogs and navigation controls remain readable. The confirmation shows 23 Nov 2026 10:00 in Malaysia and submits the corresponding 02:00 UTC. Preserved previously committed batch 3–5 screenshots.
verification.repository_lint: Still fails only in unchanged scripts/verify-seo-batch.cjs, scripts/verify-service-navbar.cjs and scripts/verify-services.cjs (83 errors, 8 warnings).
verification.production_build: Passed: RECYCLING_UI_BUILD_DIR=.next-ui-validation npx next build --no-lint. The default .next directory remains available to the running development server. Build emitted Google Fonts optimization and jose Edge Runtime dependency warnings; compilation, generated routes and type validation completed successfully. Full-repository lint limitation remains recorded separately.
verification.backend_finance_suite: 50 tests passed (43 existing, 7 new) using an isolated in-memory SQLite database; real network calls blocked
verification.batch8_regressions: 66 mocked UI regression tests passed; an additional targeted run passed all 4 receiving/management tests, adding keyboard navigation coverage for staff, admin and super-admin (69 unique cases total). Receiving covers pagination, filter reset, pending-close guard and original customer data.
verification.batch8_visual: Reviewed receiving mobile screenshot. Existing brand styles and responsive card presentation preserved.
verification.batch8_limits: Admin create/edit/conversion/evaluation/assignment/upload mutations were reviewed in source and type/build checked, but have not yet received dedicated end-to-end browser coverage in this batch. No live business submissions performed. BM availability notice remains until remaining workflow coverage and translations are verified.

limitations: Protected flows were tested with synthetic identities and intercepted API responses. Real backend/production role workflows were not exercised.
Real file transfer and external WhatsApp/email delivery were not attempted.
Original audit report and original findings remain unchanged as a baseline.
remaining_work: Finish browser verification of admin/staff request creation/editing, conversion, evaluation, assignment and upload workflows; complete other role dashboards, profile editing and administration translations. Keep BM availability notice until each module is verified.
Localize backend-authored messages and less common server-defined activity fields/enum labels; unknown values retain their original text.
Validate production role workflows and real delivery/upload/navigation integrations with authorized test accounts before release.
release_notes: Deploy the frontend and finance API updates together so search, dates and ordering are honored by the server.
No database schema migration is required for the finance filter additions.
Original audit HTML/PDF and original findings remain the baseline; this progress file records implementation status.
batch4_changes: Completed the finance list-to-detail BM flow and applied consistent MYR formatting to detail and itemized amounts.
Localized shared payout controls, bank history and activity labels while preserving original data values.
Separated the bank field label from its retry button and error so the retry control has its own accessible name; associated the bank-loading error with its select.
Corrected nested sidebar translation and removed the partial-language notice on supported finance detail routes.
batch5_changes: Localized the accounting dashboard and shared overview/chart chrome, preserving role URLs, totals, query state and user-entered profile values.
Corrected OverviewStatGrid to use three columns for three cards instead of reserving a fourth column; long metric values can wrap within their card.
Used shared MYR formatting for dashboard amounts and locale-aware UTC date formatters for chart labels.
Removed the partial-language notice on the accounting overview; unsupported modules continue to show it.
batch6_changes: Localized claim lists, filters, details, driver form, review dialogs and same-driver combined payments; claim notes, names, dates, proof keys and exact payment totals remain original data.
Added native keyboard links for claim rows and document links for receipt viewing, including PDFs supported by the backend.

Reused StatusFileUpload for receipt selection, type/size validation, visible keyboard focus, removal and upload states; domain errors are associated with the picker and reachable from validation summaries.

Blocked submission/category changes while uploads are pending; prevented stale or failed receipt uploads from being submitted as successful. Added local receipt validation using the existing RM50 default threshold; backend validation remains authoritative.
Added retry for failed vehicle lookup while retaining the selected claim category. Missing vehicles and company fleet cards retain their submission guards.
Retained role-based controls and same-driver/100-claim bulk-selection restrictions; localized shared labels and kept sidebar section keys independent of language.
batch7_changes: Completed existing partial driver pickup translations: dynamic tabs/counts, action names, material summaries, empty/error/retry states, route previews and shared order tabs now use the locale provider.
Converted API timestamps into local datetime input values for driver confirmation, reseeding the correct order time whenever the modal opens; API submissions remain UTC timestamps.
Added collection-point loading-error retry controls, retained location-denied guidance and the seven-stop optimization limit.

Blocked drop-off completion while proof uploads are pending, cleared stale proof keys before replacement uploads, cleaned up preview object URLs, named quantity inputs and rejected non-positive delivered quantities before API submission.
Added isolated production-build output via RECYCLING_UI_BUILD_DIR so production verification can coexist with a local development server without overwriting .next.
batch8_changes: Added BM presentation copy across pickup request list/detail/create/edit, quick-lead conversion, order creation/evaluation, driver assignment and cancellation components; customer values and command codes remain unchanged.
Added receiving pagination with filter resets, collection-point retries, 44px verification controls and pending-close safeguards; hide pagination on queue errors.
Added native request-detail links for keyboard navigation across staff, admin and super-admin routes.

Localized shared field errors, action labels and filter controls. Collapsed mobile filters are hidden from keyboard focus. Assignment failures offer retries and pending mutation dialogs resist dismissal.
